about: The smoke suite run by tools/dev/smoke.ps1. Each scenario is one hidden test run through shoot.ps1. Fields: name; about (what it checks, for the player); script (dev actions, tools/dev/README.md: times from app start, about 2 s after launch); shots (seconds after launch to capture: a beat after the last action); settings (extra settings.json members, starting with a comma); window (also capture this window, by part of its title); desk (also capture every window where it sits); mind (point the profile at tools/dev/mock_mind.py); mindReply; mindRequests (the least the mock must be asked); expect (regexes, case-sensitive, that some log line must match); forbid (more regexes no log line may match, on top of ERROR, Exception and SCRIPT ERROR); ignore (regexes for known harmless lines). The top-level ignore applies to every scenario. Calibrate expect and ignore from real runs; never loosen forbid to make a run pass.

scenarios.name: boot
scenarios.about: A fresh profile: the cabinet and the companion come up and nothing in the log goes wrong.

scenarios.name: firstrun
scenarios.about: A new player's first run: the Welcome opens beside the cabinet.

scenarios.name: settings
scenarios.about: Every Settings page opens, and none is wider than the window (settingswidths logs any that is).

scenarios.name: chat
scenarios.about: Saying something to the companion reaches their mind (the mock), and their reply shows in their bubble.
scenarios.mindReply: Hi! It's good to see you. How did today go?

scenarios.name: memory
scenarios.about: The memory book opens on its tabs with a few seeded notes, facts and agenda items.

scenarios.name: crt
scenarios.about: The CRT's small system opens, then its MEMOS app.

scenarios.name: reminder
scenarios.about: A reminder set a few seconds ahead goes off, with its ticket.

scenarios.name: focus
scenarios.about: A focus session starts from the screen and counts down on it.

scenarios.name: memos
scenarios.about: Memos hang and pin on the cabinet's side, and the hanging one opens as a sheet.
